marker.description: A blue-headed pin is inserted into the cross-section of the penis, likely indicating the corpus spongiosum or the deep dorsal vein.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pin.
main_explanation: The pin is located in the ventral (inferior) portion of the penile cross-section, which corresponds to the corpus spongiosum, the erectile tissue that surrounds the urethra.
